questions.q: What is the Building Average LPD for a Residential Dwelling: Condominium?
questions.n: This value represents the standard allowable lighting power density in watts per square meter for residential condominiums.

questions.q: What is the Building Average LPD for a Hotel / Resort?
questions.n: Hotels and resorts share the same LPD requirement as residential condominiums and offices.

questions.q: What is the Building Average LPD for an Educational: School?
questions.n: Educational facilities are permitted a slightly higher LPD of 12.9 to accommodate classroom lighting needs.

questions.q: What is the Building Average LPD for an Institutional: Hospital?
questions.n: Hospitals share the 12.9 LPD requirement with educational institutions.

questions.q: What is the Building Average LPD for a Business: Office?
questions.n: Business offices fall under the 10.8 LPD category alongside residential condominiums.

questions.q: What is the Building Average LPD for a Mercantile: Mall?
questions.n: Mercantile spaces have the highest general allowance to support commercial activity, provided accent lighting is separate.

questions.q: What is the TGFA as defined by NBC for a Residential Dwelling: Condominium¹?
questions.n: Residential condominiums have a higher TGFA threshold of 20,000 sqm.

questions.q: What is the TGFA as defined by NBC for a Hotel / Resort?
questions.n: Hotels and resorts are classified under the 10,000 sqm TGFA threshold.

questions.q: What is the TGFA as defined by NBC for an Educational: School?
questions.n: Educational facilities share the 10,000 sqm TGFA requirement with offices and hospitals.

questions.q: What is the TGFA as defined by NBC for an Institutional: Hospital?
questions.n: Institutional hospitals fall under the 10,000 sqm category.

questions.q: What is the TGFA as defined by NBC for a Business: Office?
questions.n: Business offices require a TGFA of 10,000 sqm according to these NBC definitions.

questions.q: What is the TGFA as defined by NBC for a Mercantile: Mall?
questions.n: Mercantile malls have a specific TGFA threshold of 15,000 sqm.

questions.q: What is the TGFA as defined by NBC for a Mixed Occupancy²?
questions.n: Mixed occupancy buildings follow the 10,000 sqm TGFA standard.

questions.q: What is the Average LPD for Covered parking?
questions.n: Covered parking areas are allowed 3.2 W/sqm to ensure adequate visibility in enclosed structures.

questions.q: What is the Average LPD for Open and outdoor parking?
questions.n: Open and outdoor parking has the lowest LPD requirement at 1.6 W/sqm.

questions.q: What is the Average LPD for Exterior Façade?
questions.n: Exterior facades are allocated 2.15 W/sqm for lighting.

questions.q: What is the Average LPD for an Active entrance (pedestrian conveyance)?
questions.n: Active entrances for pedestrian conveyance require the highest LPD of 98.4 W/sqm for safety and high traffic.

questions.q: What is the Average LPD for an Inactive entrance (normally locked / inactive use)?
questions.n: Inactive or normally locked entrances have an LPD requirement of 65.6 W/sqm.
